real_flaw: lending pool transfers borrowed asset before updating borrows/collateral; hook-calling token reenters borrow (no reentrancy guard)
flag_gate: attacker borrowed-token balance >= profit_threshold, reachable only via the borrow reentrancy (honest borrowing is bounded by collateral * collateralFactor < threshold)

contracts.AssetToken: OpenZeppelin ERC20 v5.1.0 (stock, fixed-supply mint in constructor) — the collateral token
contracts.HookToken: ERC-20 that fires ITokenReceiver(to).tokensReceived after _update (faithful EIP-777 recipient hook) — the borrowable token
contracts.LendingPool: Cream/Compound-style market: supplyCollateral(asset) then borrow(hook); borrow pays out before updating borrows, no guard (vulnerable)
contracts.LendingPoolSafe: fixed: OZ ReentrancyGuard + CEI (update borrows before payout) — the documented fix (negative test)
contracts.FlagVault: claim(taskId,flag) gated on borrowed-token balance >= profitThreshold AND keccak256(flag) == expectedHash
